decisions.rationale: Influenza A virus is a known cause of respiratory infections, and leaf B3.6 is labeled as 'influenza', indicating a direct relationship.
Group A Streptococcus can cause epiglottitis and peritonsillar abscess
Haemophilus influenzae type b can cause epiglottitis and peritonsillar abscess
Mycoplasma pneumoniae is more commonly associated with pneumonia
Staphylococcus aureus is more commonly associated with skin and soft tissue infections
Adenovirus can cause croup
Influenza A virus is more commonly associated with influenza-like illness
Respiratory syncytial virus is more commonly associated with bronchiolitis
Epstein-Barr virus is more commonly associated with infectious mononucleosis
Corynebacterium diphtheriae can cause epiglottitis
